{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Verify QA orders
qa_orders = df[df['revenue'] == '999999.99']
print(f"Number of QA orders: {len(qa_orders)}")

# Verify refunded orders
refunded_orders = df[df['status'] == 'refunded']
print(f"Number of refunded orders: {len(refunded_orders)}")

# Compute conversion rate by customer_segment
conversion_rate_by_segment = df.groupby('customer_segment')['converted'].mean() * 100

# Print the full conversion rate series
print("\nConversion rates by customer_segment (percent):")
print(conversion_rate_by_segment)

# Extract and print the values explicitly
loyal_rate = conversion_rate_by_segment['loyal']
returning_rate = conversion_rate_by_segment['returning']
new_rate = conversion_rate_by_segment['new']

print(f"\nLoyal conversion rate: {loyal_rate}")
print(f"Returning conversion rate: {returning_rate}")
print(f"New conversion rate: {new_rate}")

# Find the best segment
best_segment = conversion_rate_by_segment.idxmax()
best_rate = conversion_rate_by_segment.max()

print(f"\nBest segment: {best_segment}")
print(f"Best rate: {best_rate}")"}
